title: Asked
subtitle: 問、詢問、要求、請求、追問、盤問——英文會按目的、語氣、對象、正式程度、提問方式選用不同的字。
description: 問、詢問、要求、請求、追問、盤問——英文會按目的、語氣、對象、正式程度、提問方式選用不同的字。

words.note: 向某人問問題，通常比 asked 更強調「提問這個動作」。在警察、記者、調查或正式情境中尤其常見，但不一定帶有敵意。
words.example: The police questioned several witnesses about what they had seen.
words.exampleZh: 警方詢問了幾名目擊者，了解他們看見了甚麼。

exercises.original: The police asked several witnesses about what they had seen.
exercises.zh: 警方詢問了幾名目擊者，了解他們看見了甚麼。
exercises.upgrade: The police questioned several witnesses about what they had seen.

options.explanation: — replied 是「回答」，方向相反；警方是在提出問題。
— 正式向目擊者提出問題，符合調查語境。
— invited 是邀請參與或出席，不是調查性提問。
— explained 是提供說明，不是索取資料。
— requested 偏向要求物件或行動；這裡重點是問問題。
— wondered 可只表示心中想知道，不代表真正向目擊者提問。

exercises.original: Investigators asked the employee about the missing documents.
exercises.zh: 調查人員就失蹤的文件向該名員工問話。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators questioned the employee about the missing documents.

options.explanation: — question someone about something 是自然搭配，特別適合調查情境。
— 表示提出建議，不是向員工查問。
— 表示回答，角色方向相反。
— 通常表示要求某物或某行動；這裡明確是問話。

words.note: 為取得資料、詳情或實際資訊而詢問。語氣通常較禮貌或正式。英式英語常寫 enquired; inquired 也很常見，尤其在美式英語。
words.example: She enquired about the cost of the evening course.
words.exampleZh: 她查詢了夜間課程的費用。

exercises.original: She asked about the cost of the evening course.
exercises.zh: 她查詢了夜間課程的費用。
exercises.upgrade: She enquired about the cost of the evening course.

options.explanation: — 表示強烈要求，不符合一般查詢價格的語氣。
— enquire about the cost 很自然，表示為取得資訊而查詢。
— 涉及有系統地向某人提出一連串問題。
— 表示討論，不等於詢問價格。

exercises.original: He asked whether any rooms were available for Friday night.
exercises.zh: 他查詢星期五晚上是否有空房。
exercises.upgrade: He enquired whether any rooms were available for Friday night.

options.explanation: — 表示命令；查詢空房沒有命令意味。
— enquire whether... 適合較禮貌、正式的資訊查詢。
— 表示連續提問或測問，不符合一次住宿查詢。
— 通常是徵求意見、支持等，不是查詢空房。

words.note: 對某項資料、說法、收費、數字或決定提出問題，往往暗示需要核實、澄清或可能有疑問。常見於書面、行政、商業及技術語境。
words.example: The customer queried an unexpected charge on the bill.
words.exampleZh: 顧客就帳單上一項意外收費提出查問。

exercises.original: The customer asked about an unexpected charge on the bill.
exercises.zh: 顧客就帳單上一項意外收費提出查問。
exercises.upgrade: The customer queried an unexpected charge on the bill.

options.explanation: — 對帳單上一個具體項目提出疑問，query a charge 很貼切。
— 通常接 advice/help/clarification 等；不能自然地說 sought a charge。

exercises.original: The auditor asked why the total did not match the figures in the report.
exercises.zh: 核數師對總數為何與報告中的數字不符提出疑問。
exercises.upgrade: The auditor queried why the total did not match the figures in the report.

options.explanation: — 有核實數字、質疑不一致之意。
— 提供解釋，而核數師正在要求解釋。
— 不需要完整訪談的含義。

words.note: 禮貌或正式地要求某物、某項行動或某項服務。重點不是取得答案，而是希望對方提供或做某事。
words.example: She requested a copy of the final report.
words.exampleZh: 她要求取得一份最終報告的副本。

exercises.original: She asked for a copy of the final report.
exercises.zh: 她要求取得一份最終報告的副本。
exercises.upgrade: She requested a copy of the final report.

options.explanation: — 正式要求取得某物，最自然。

exercises.original: The hospital asked that visitors switch off their phones.
exercises.zh: 醫院要求訪客關掉手機。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital requested that visitors switch off their phones.

options.explanation: — request that... 是正式要求採取行動。
— 只是想知道，不會要求訪客做事。

words.note: 主動嘗試取得資訊、意見、批准、幫助或解決方法。它不一定表示直接開口問了一句話，而是強調「尋求取得」。
words.example: The team sought advice from an independent expert.
words.exampleZh: 團隊向一名獨立專家尋求意見。

exercises.original: The team asked an independent expert for advice.
exercises.zh: 團隊向一名獨立專家尋求意見。
exercises.upgrade: The team sought advice from an independent expert.

options.explanation: — seek advice 表示主動尋求意見，精準自然。
— 強烈要求，不符合請教專家的中性語氣。
— 提供說明，而非尋求說明。

exercises.original: Before changing the design, the engineers asked for clarification from the client.
exercises.zh: 工程師在更改設計前向客戶尋求澄清。
exercises.upgrade: Before changing the design, the engineers sought clarification from the client.

options.explanation: — seek clarification 是非常自然的正式搭配。
— 是系統性訪問，不只是要求澄清。

words.note: 主動要求別人提供意見、回應、建議、捐款、支持或其他東西。比 asked for 正式，而且常表示有目的地向多人或特定人士徵集。
words.example: The committee solicited feedback from staff before changing the policy.
words.exampleZh: 委員會在更改政策前徵求員工意見。

exercises.original: The committee asked staff for feedback before changing the policy.
exercises.zh: 委員會在更改政策前徵求員工意見。
exercises.upgrade: The committee solicited feedback from staff before changing the policy.

options.explanation: — solicit feedback 是正式地徵集回應。
— 強烈要求，沒有「徵集意見」的核心意思。

exercises.original: The charity asked local companies for donations.
exercises.zh: 該慈善機構向本地公司徵求捐款。
exercises.upgrade: The charity solicited donations from local companies.

options.explanation: — solicit donations 是固定而自然的正式搭配。

words.note: 向具有知識、專業或相關經驗的人尋求意見。重點是對方被視為可提供指導的人。
words.example: The manager consulted a lawyer before signing the agreement.
words.exampleZh: 經理在簽署協議前諮詢了一名律師。

exercises.original: The manager asked a lawyer for advice before signing the agreement.
exercises.zh: 經理在簽署協議前諮詢了一名律師。
exercises.upgrade: The manager consulted a lawyer before signing the agreement.

options.explanation: — 強烈要求，不合專業請教語境。
— 律師是專業人士；向其尋求意見正是 consult。
— 連番查問或測問，不等於正式諮詢。

exercises.original: She asked her doctor about the possible side effects.
exercises.zh: 她向醫生諮詢可能出現的副作用。
exercises.upgrade: She consulted her doctor about the possible side effects.

options.explanation: — 醫療問診可包含提問，但這句重點是病人向專家求意見。
— consult a doctor about... 最準確。
— 通常徵集回饋、意見、捐款等；這裡更自然是 consulted。

words.meaning: 訪問；面試；有系統地提問
words.note: 為取得資料、評估某人或進行報道而有計劃地提出一連串問題。
words.example: The researcher interviewed twenty parents about their children's reading habits.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員訪問了二十名家長，了解他們子女的閱讀習慣。

exercises.original: The researcher asked twenty parents a series of questions about children's reading habits.
exercises.zh: 研究人員就兒童閱讀習慣向二十名家長進行了一系列訪問。
exercises.upgrade: The researcher interviewed twenty parents about children's reading habits.

options.explanation: — 多名參與者、一系列有目的問題，典型研究訪談。

exercises.original: The company asked each candidate detailed questions about their experience.
exercises.zh: 公司就工作經驗向每名應徵者進行詳細面試。
exercises.upgrade: The company interviewed each candidate about their experience.

options.explanation: — 可徵求資訊，但不能自然表達完整招聘面試。
— 求職情境中有系統地問應徵者問題。
— 可以查詢資料，但沒有完整面試程序的含義。

words.note: 以強烈、持續、正式的方式向某人提出大量問題，通常與警方、軍事、安全、調查或懷疑有關。
words.example: The suspect was interrogated for several hours.

exercises.original: The suspect was asked questions for several hours about his movements that night.
exercises.zh: 疑犯就當晚的行蹤被盤問了數小時。
exercises.upgrade: The suspect was interrogated for several hours about his movements that night.

options.explanation: — 疑犯、數小時、調查性問題，符合正式盤問。

exercises.original: Security officers repeatedly asked the man where he had obtained the access card.
exercises.zh: 保安人員反覆盤問該男子從哪裡取得門禁卡。
exercises.upgrade: Security officers interrogated the man about where he had obtained the access card.

options.explanation: — 權力關係、反覆提問及安全調查令此字最貼切。
— 可尋求資料，但不表示對某人進行強力盤問。

words.note: 向某人提出一系列問題，可以是想詳細了解某事，也可以是測試知識。語氣通常比 interrogated 輕，但比普通 asked 更密集。
words.example: Reporters quizzed the coach about the team's sudden change in strategy.
words.exampleZh: 記者連番追問教練球隊突然改變策略的原因。

exercises.original: Reporters asked the coach many questions about the sudden change in strategy.
exercises.zh: 記者就球隊突然改變策略連番追問教練。
exercises.upgrade: Reporters quizzed the coach about the sudden change in strategy.

options.explanation: — 多名記者連續追問，語氣密集但未必像 interrogated 那麼嚴厲。

exercises.original: The teacher asked the students several questions about yesterday's vocabulary.
exercises.zh: 老師就昨天的詞彙向學生作了幾道測問。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher quizzed the students on yesterday's vocabulary.

options.explanation: — 強烈要求，不合測驗語境。
— 面試／訪談，不是知識測試。
— quiz students on vocabulary 正是測問知識。

words.note: 在對方沒有充分回答、避免回答或事情很重要時，繼續要求答案或解釋。
words.example: When he avoided the question, the journalist pressed him for a clear answer.
words.exampleZh: 當他避開問題時，記者追問他，要求一個清楚的答案。

exercises.original: When the minister avoided the question, the journalist asked again for a clear answer.
exercises.zh: 當對方避開問題時，記者追問並要求一個清楚的答案。
exercises.upgrade: When the minister avoided the question, the journalist pressed him for a clear answer.

options.explanation: — 對方避答後仍堅持索取答案，正是 press someone for an answer。
— 可能描述整場訪問，但沒有「因避答而追問」的精確含義。

exercises.original: Shareholders asked the board repeatedly for more details about the losses.
exercises.zh: 股東反覆追問董事會有關虧損的更多詳情。
exercises.upgrade: Shareholders pressed the board for more details about the losses.

options.explanation: — 徵集回應或意見，但沒有持續施壓的意味。
— press someone for details 表示堅持追問。

words.note: 禮貌地請某人出席、參與、發言、回應或採取某項行動。它是 asked 的一種社交／參與型用法。
words.example: She was invited to speak at the conference.

exercises.original: The organizers asked her to speak at the conference.
exercises.zh: 主辦方邀請她在會議上發言。
exercises.upgrade: The organizers invited her to speak at the conference.

options.explanation: — 請某人參與會議並發言，典型邀請。
— 強烈要求，會改變原句禮貌、自願的社交含義。

exercises.original: At the end of the presentation, the speaker asked the audience to raise questions.
exercises.zh: 演講者在簡報結束時邀請觀眾提出問題。
exercises.upgrade: At the end of the presentation, the speaker invited questions from the audience.

options.explanation: — 文法上可表示要求，但這裡典型語用是開放、鼓勵參與。
— invite questions 表示歡迎觀眾提出問題。

words.note: 帶有強烈情感、急切或絕望地請求某人做某事。
words.example: He begged the doctor to try one more treatment.
words.exampleZh: 他懇求醫生再嘗試一次治療。

exercises.original: He desperately asked the doctor to try one more treatment.
exercises.zh: 他絕望地懇求醫生再嘗試一次治療。
exercises.upgrade: He begged the doctor to try one more treatment.

options.explanation: — desperately 表明強烈情感和急切懇求。
— 正式徵求，不符合情感強度。

exercises.original: The child asked his parents again and again not to leave him alone.
exercises.zh: 孩子一次又一次懇求父母不要留下他一個人。
exercises.upgrade: The child begged his parents not to leave him alone.

options.explanation: — 反覆、帶感情地請求，非常符合語境。
— 可以表示正式請求，但情感強度不足。

words.meaning: 強烈要求；要求立即得到
words.note: 以強硬、堅決或帶有權利感的方式要求答案、解釋、行動或物件。
words.example: The passengers demanded an explanation for the long delay.
words.exampleZh: 乘客強烈要求解釋長時間延誤的原因。

exercises.original: The passengers angrily asked for an explanation for the long delay.
exercises.zh: 乘客憤怒地強烈要求解釋長時間延誤的原因。
exercises.upgrade: The passengers demanded an explanation for the long delay.

options.explanation: — 心中想知道，沒有直接強烈要求。
— angrily 加上要求解釋，表示強硬地索取答案。

exercises.original: The union asked that the company reverse the decision immediately.
exercises.zh: 工會強烈要求公司立即撤回該決定。
exercises.upgrade: The union demanded that the company reverse the decision immediately.

options.explanation: — immediately 配合組織對公司的強硬要求，demand that... 最精準。
— 查詢資訊，不是要求政策行動。
— 徵集意見或支持，不是要求撤回決定。

falseSynonyms.zh: 說了 ≠ 問了 said 表示說出內容；told 通常表示把資訊告訴某人。兩者本身都不表示提出問題。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison She asked where the station was. She said that she was lost. She told me that the station was nearby.

falseSynonyms.zh: 回答 ≠ 提問 answered 和 replied 描述對問題、訊息或說話的回應，不是發起問題。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison I asked when the meeting would start. He answered at once.

falseSynonyms.zh: 心裡想知道 ≠ 直接詢問 wondered 可以表示某人想知道某事，但未必真的向任何人提出問題。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison She wondered why he was late. She asked him why he was late.

falseSynonyms.zh: 討論 ≠ 詢問 discussed 表示交換意見或談論某個主題。討論中可能包含很多問題，但這個動詞本身不是「問」。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison They discussed the new policy. They asked the director several questions about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 解釋 ≠ 查問 explained 表示提供理由、資料或說明；它通常是回答的一部分，而不是提問。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison The student asked why the rule had changed. The teacher explained the reason.

falseSynonyms.zh: 建議 ≠ 請求 suggested 提出想法或方案；requested 是要求某人提供東西或採取行動。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison She suggested meeting earlier. She requested an earlier appointment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 命令 ≠ 詢問／請求 ordered 表示利用權力直接指示某人做事。雖然 asked someone to... 有時也會導致行動，但普通 asked 不含命令的權力和強制意味。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison The officer asked the driver to wait. The officer ordered the driver to stop immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞 ≠ 過去式動詞 question, enquiry, request 可以是名詞；題目如果需要表示「某人做了詢問／請求」的過去式動詞，就要檢查詞性。
falseSynonyms.point: English comparison She enquired about the course. Her enquiry was answered the next day.
